purpose.zh: 练手臂举过头时，肩胛骨跟着往上转、贴住身体
purpose.en: Train your shoulder blades to turn up and stay against your ribs as your arms go overhead.

text.zh: 前臂压住泡沫轴，顺着墙往上滚
text.en: Press your forearms into the roller and roll it up the wall

text.zh: 面向墙站直，两前臂平行，掌心相对。
text.en: Stand tall facing the wall, forearms parallel, palms facing each other.

text.zh: 滚到最高处，肩膀往前送一点，停一下再滑下。
text.en: At the top, reach your shoulders forward a little, pause, then slide down.

cautions.zh: 肩膀疼时少往上滑一点，还疼就停
cautions.en: If your shoulders hurt, slide up less, and stop if it still hurts.

changes: 节奏按 spec：上滚 1.3 s → 顶端停 1.5 s（其间肩往前送）→ 滑下 1.0 s → 休 0.2 s
「停2秒」改「停一下」（动画顶端约 1.5 s）；peak 口令「停两秒」→「肩往前送」与动画一致
purpose 去掉术语「上旋」；cautions 改短句
flags: 批表 slide 轨 go 1.07/hold 1.72 与 spec 关键帧不符，按 spec 手算
